title: Port execute preflight, stop/settle ordering and done lifetime
scope: Complete execute orchestration over owned stop/settle/guarded providers. Preserve strict discard classification, raw busy null distinction, preflight before done construction, deferred branching, ordered waits and finally resolution. Guarded command execution remains a separately owned provider.
acceptance: Complete original registry/activity graph compares orchestration effects and done/caller state on independent preflight/wait/body schedules before native execution; guarded activity/history remains provider scope.
Preflight failures never create done; later faults resolve done; empty busy text still selects stop; every started wait/body remains owned and bounded native waiters stay distinct from source errors.
open_items: Implement complete orchestration at typed provider boundary; guarded body/history/deadline integration and actual session commands remain separate.
